context.ontologyPurpose: The registered ObjectTypes and LinkTypes - the typed vocabulary the control plane reasons over (resources, actions, and the causal links between them). Read-only reference.
context.impactPurpose: Simulates how many resources one action could reach by traversing the resource graph from a target. The safety check caps the impact scope so a single change can never touch more than its scope. Read-only what-if.

map.title: Catalog topology

map.communityHint: {count} link communities - drag nodes or canvas - wheel to zoom

blast.partialCoverageHint: one or more bounds or verification gaps remain

blast.resourceResultsBounded: Showing {count} bounded results. Narrow the search to reach another Resource.
blast.resourceDetailsLoading: Loading type, resource group, and location...
blast.resourceDetailsUnavailable: Resource details are unavailable; the exact selected id is preserved.
blast.exactResourceIdHint: Use direct entry only when you already have the canonical Resource id. The server revalidates it before simulation.
blast.idle: Enter a target and select at least one link type to simulate impact.
blast.noReachable: No reachable resources at this depth.

blast.selectedNodeDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. It remains observation-only.
blast.selectedUnverifiedDescription: Reached at depth {depth}, but the stored {link} relationship is not verified. The simulation does not infer missing evidence.
blast.selectedConfigurationDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. A current reviewed provider configuration and deterministic cross-check confirm this edge.
blast.selectedIndependentDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. A current independent observation receipt confirms this edge.
blast.selectedStaleDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship, but its retained evidence is outside the freshness ceiling.
blast.selectedSourceIncompleteDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. Configuration provenance is retained, but the authoritative relationship source generation is incomplete.
blast.selectedCoverageUnavailableDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. Configuration provenance is retained, but source coverage accounting is unavailable for this generation.
blast.selectedUnavailableDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship, but no current relationship evidence is available.
blast.selectedLegacyDescription: Reached at depth {depth} through the stored {link} relationship. This legacy response does not carry the evidence needed for a current verification claim.

evidenceReason.relationship_source_incomplete: Complete and promote the authoritative relationship source generation before treating configuration edges as verified.

evidenceReason.relationship_evidence_future_cutoff: Reconcile the source and inventory clocks, then collect a new complete generation.
evidenceReason.relationship_evidence_stale: Run a fresh authoritative inventory collection and promote its relationship evidence.
